sections.Purpose: We keep everything needed to build, configure, deploy, run and recover a solution in version control, with a complete and attributable history. If one asset needed to rebuild the system is not versioned, we cannot claim the system is reproducible. A schema migration gets the same rigour as an application change.
sections.Scope:
All solutions we build or operate, and every asset required to rebuild them: application code, infrastructure definitions, database schema and migrations, pipeline definitions, non-secret configuration, operational scripts and the documentation that describes them.

Secrets are the deliberate exception. See [pol-SCRT].
sections.Exceptions: Vendor-supplied binaries and third-party assets we cannot keep in source are referenced by version and provenance instead. See [pol-TRUS]. Any other asset kept outside version control requires a recorded deviation under [pol-DEVI], naming the asset, the reason and the recovery plan if it is lost.
